_token_discipline: verdict/closer/survival fields use ONLY frozen FACG-001A-R3 gate_spec tokens; *_gloss fields are human descriptions, NOT new taxonomy tokens.

survival_conditions.S-1_gloss: Claimant did not carry the S-1 burden. NOT an R-alone refutation: the shared-R protocol is FACG's fairness requirement, not an auto-fail. The G+R combination provides no no-closing-reference structure beyond a fixed shared law / fixed J|V / fixed simulator; agent-generated niche is ordinary history dependence.

claim_cap_only.gloss: Ideal object exists (simulator reproducible) -> caps claim at capability and blocks subject/mechanism overclaim. Does NOT by itself prove a resource-matched shadow (K-A1b).

closers_fired_gloss.K-A5: FIXED_EMBODIED_GAME: embodiment changes the access tuple, not identifiability/separability; fixed-prior embodied MDP has an ideal reference; escapes only via S-1 (not established).
closers_fired_gloss.K-A2: CAPABILITY_RELABEL: any win via explicit boundary/controllability machinery is architecture / sample-efficiency / mechanism-family capability unless the full B1-B9 incl. B7 U-disabled are beaten AND a U-ablation shows non-transferable mechanism necessity.
closers_fired_gloss.K-A6: GRAPH_CACHE_HISTORY_COVERAGE: fixed-prior cross-episode accumulation (U2/U4) is amortized and covered by B3/B5.

domination_status.gloss: Closure rests on analytic baseline-coverage + capability relabel, NOT on an executed or formally-proven equal-resource domination. META_AMORTIZED_COLLAPSE is deliberately NOT used as the primary verdict.

supporting_reductions.gloss: U1 controllability kernel P(var responds | intervention, context) reduces to the c1 / CDAP Row-2 interventional-prediction functional; shadowed under CSSP-001A logic. CSSP-001A is not banked in repo, so this reduction is CONJECTURE-grade. It is a SUPPORTING reduction for the U1 component only, NOT a whole-C proof.

whole_C_closure_basis: U3 viability-weighted repair -> optimal control against a fixed given J|V -> covered by B1/B4 at equal R
U2/U4 boundary-state + replay -> covered by B3/B5 (history-memory / graph-cache)
best-case empirical win is architecture/efficiency -> K-A2 relabel -> CAPABILITY_NOT_SUBJECT / MECHANISM_FAMILY_REPLICATION

fairness_self_check.gloss: Tuple is format-compliant and seriously constructed; NOT closed by U_BOUNDARY_OVERBROAD or a definitional kill. Closed substantively by S-1 non-establishment + K-A2 amortizability/relabel + K-A6 coverage.
